title: John Dee's Enochian angel language

as_told.title: John Dee claimed to speak with angels at Queen Elizabeth's court
as_told.place_text: England, court of Queen Elizabeth I

plain: John Dee, a magician and chief spy at the court of Queen Elizabeth I, is said to have claimed he spoke with angels through a special language he called Enochian. Michels brings this up himself, without naming a source, in two episodes; in the second he describes Dee as a magician who blurred the line between magic and talking to angels, and leaves out the language. It is told as an early case of someone claiming contact with beings beyond the human.
